join hortbot 999 foobar 1
join hortbot 999 otherchan 9

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add pan FOUND THE (_PARAMETER_CAPS_), HAVE YE?
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!pan working command
send hortbot #foobar [HB] FOUND THE WORKING COMMAND, HAVE YE?

handle hortbot otherchan/9 otherchan/9 :!pan working command
no_send

handle hortbot otherchan/9 otherchan/9 :!#foobar/pan working command
send hortbot #otherchan [HB] FOUND THE WORKING COMMAND, HAVE YE?

handle hortbot otherchan/9 random/2 :!#foobar/pan working command
no_send

handle hortbot otherchan/9 random/2 access=subscriber :!#foobar/pan working command
no_send

handle hortbot otherchan/9 random/2 access=moderator :!#foobar/pan working command
no_send


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list add mylist
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist add thing 1
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mylist add thing 2
send_any


handle hortbot otherchan/9 otherchan/9 :!#foobar/mylist get 1
send hortbot #otherchan [HB] thing 1


handle hortbot otherchan/9 otherchan/9 :!#who/mylist get 1
send hortbot #otherchan [HB] Channel who does not exist.
